question: 'Romancing with Life' is an autobiography of the evergreen star ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Dev Anand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Romancing with Life:-**

 
 
• Dev Anand's autobiography, "Romancing with Life", was published in 2007.
 
• **It is a candid and engaging account of his life and career, from his humble beginnings in Gurdaspur, India, to his rise to stardom as one of Bollywood's most iconic actors.**
 
• Anand writes about his struggles and successes, his loves and losses, and his unique philosophy on life.
 
• He also shares his insights into the Indian film industry and the people who have shaped his career.
 
 
 
• **Dev Anand:-**
 
 
• **He was an Indian actor, writer, director, and producer known for his work in Hindi cinema. **
 
• Anand is considered one of the greatest and most successful actors in the history of Indian cinema.
 
• Anand is a recipient of four Filmfare Awards, including two for Best Actor. The Government of India honored him with Padma Bhushan, Indian third highest civilian honour in 2001 and with Dadasaheb Phalke Award in 2002.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dilip Kumar:-**

 
 
• **He was an Indian actor who worked in Hindi cinema. **
 
• Kumar holds the record for most wins for the Filmfare Award for Best Actor (eight, which was later equalled by Shah Rukh Khan) and was also the inaugural recipient of the award.
 
• He is also referred to as The First Khan of Hindi Cinema.
 
 
 
• **Kishore Kumar:-**
 
 
• **He was an Indian playback singer, actor, lyricist, composer, producer, and screenwriter. **
 
• He was one of the most popular and successful playback singers in the history of Indian cinema, and is known for his versatility and wide range of vocal styles.
 
 
 
• **Shashi Kapoor:-**
 
 
• **He was an Indian actor, producer, and director known for his work in Hindi cinema. **
 
• He was the youngest son of Prithviraj Kapoor and the younger brother of Raj Kapoor and Shammi Kapoor.
